title: Next to and In Front of: Mellett and Előtt

sections.content:
Two indispensable postpositions for locating buildings and places around town:
- **mellett** = next to, beside
  - *a ház mellett* = next to the house
  - *a kávézó mellett* = next to the cafe
- **előtt** = in front of (spatial)
  - *a mozi előtt* = in front of the cinema
  - *a bejárat előtt* = in front of the entrance

items.english: We are meeting in front of the cinema.

items.spanish: A bank a posta mellett van.
items.english: The bank is next to the post office.
